c.responsibility: Design the frontend for a cart and multi-step checkout. Pricing, stock reservations, payment processing and order creation are server capabilities. Show how the UI prevents duplicate actions and recovers after refresh or uncertain payment outcomes.
c.contract: props: identity, locale and initial data; events: selection, change, retry; local contract below
c.rendering: Cart of up to 100 lines; delay payment SDK load until needed, avoid full-page rerenders on every keystroke.
c.accessibility: Native form labels and autocomplete attributes, inline error associations, focus first invalid field, step headings and an announced pending state. A visual spinner alone does not communicate submission.

n.no: Coordinates this feature. Model checkout as explicit states and guard transitions. Disable repeated submit while pending but also reuse one idempotency key for retries of the same attempt. Payment provider fields tokenize sensitive input; query order status after an ambiguous timeout before starting a new attempt. Alternative: Optimistic quantity updates feel fast but need version reconciliation. Pessimistic final checkout is clearer where price and stock must be confirmed.
